text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"'The "Emperor", Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume!'
'Take on the world, Symboli Rudolf'... 
'The next generation's "Emperor", a new legend in the making?'"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Aah.
I got overtaken, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing training, I was out on a stroll with Mr. C.B. for the first time in a while, when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang! ...Thud!)
Say that again, you bastard!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Two slurring men were grappling with each other. ...It seemed one of them was unilaterally enraged—

"CB can't become a legend? She'll be forgotten
in no time? Don't mess with me!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, me?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Isn't that person...
that UmaTube streamer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Looking closely, the one furiously shouting was indeed
that young man I had seen several times before."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hup, there we go. Man, you're covered in bruises.
Are you okay? Can you drink some water?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
......
...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: So, why were you guys fighting in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: “...... That is—”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...
You guys were fighting over me, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If it were anyone else's business, I'd leave it alone, but...
...What happened?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pinned by those piercing eyes, he gave up and slowly began to speak, word by word.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since I watched my first race a few years ago,
I've been totally hooked on this world."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I researched past races from start to finish,
learned about the drama... and found out about the girls
known as legendary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Just hearing stories about girls like that gets my heart racing. It makes me regret not getting interested sooner—I could've seen some of them in person.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...That was when you—
when Mr. C.B. appeared."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
My heart was completely stolen when I watched her debut race.
I just knew there was something different about this girl compared to other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I had crazy high hopes. I thought she might even become a legendary Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I've been following them ever since...
Getting nervous before races, overjoyed when they win!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"I only ever knew about the legendary Umamusume of the past
from trivia and books, so this was a first for me."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: "Someone who makes you feel like you're running right beside them, who can surpass past legends and become the strongest in history—someone who lets you dream like that."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
......
Your success was my success.
I took pride in it as if it were my own.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...I guess I placed all my expectations on you
and piled my own dream onto your life."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
So... I wanted her to succeed endlessly.
I wanted her to be the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Yet you never meet us halfway.
You just run however you please, and when you lose, you lose.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"I have no interest in being 'the strongest.'
Staying true to yourself was all that mattered."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: And then Rudolf appeared.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume blessed with just as much raw talent.
And she will carry it all for us.
She's trying to make our wish come true.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's hearts swayed toward Rudolf.
I thought, 'Yeah, that makes sense,' too. But—"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
When I went out for a drink earlier,
some old guys who love racing were talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...'C.B. is first-rate, but she'll never be a legend,'
'Symboli Rudolf is the one who will lead
the racing world into the future.'"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: "They said, 'Once CB retires, she probably won't be talked about much anymore.'"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Even though... I myself thought
that might just be the case—"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Hearing their words made my blood boil.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: CB isn't finished yet.

text_block_list.name: Drunken Man A
text_block_list.text: ...What, you a fan of C.B., bro? My bad, hope I didn't upset you.

text_block_list.name: Drunken Man B
text_block_list.text:
No, but you shouldn't get your hopes up.
Don't obsess over it; you need to be pragmatic in races.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: —Say that again, you bastard!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"CB can't become a legend? She'll be forgotten
in no time? Don't mess with me!"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...As I grabbed their collar in a fit of rage,
I wondered what on earth I was saying."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Even I was ready to give up on you.
I didn't even understand why I was so pissed off.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...I hate the idea of you losing.
And I hate the idea of you not trying to be the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Still, I hate being put down even more.
...Don't really get why, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the young man fall silent like that,
Mr. C.B. sat down right beside him,
as if offering comfort.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "...I bet that even now, you still hold an ideal version of me inside your heart."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
To surpass even that "mythology,"
there is a Mr. C.B. running cleverly and true.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's frustrating when things don't go as planned,
and infuriating when outsiders talk down on me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: On top of that, looking at her, she even feels a little bad towards me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, I don't really mind
if you guys project some 'mythology' onto me."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't care how people see me.
You can give me a role. You can place your dreams on me.
You can talk about me as a legend, too—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You can use me as an excuse to drag me down.
You can start cheering for someone else instead.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens,
I'm not changing my stance.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: D-Does that mean it doesn't matter? To people like us—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No, that place is the freest place in the world.
It's not for me to decide how you all do things.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"You guys should watch however you like.
Just like how I run however I like. Am I wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
............
...How can you say something like that?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Even though it was practically as if I attacked you...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing what you said made me realize something.
You love racing just as much, in your own way."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing so noble.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I was just trying to use you,
just so I could say
that I had witnessed a "myth"――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, so—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...It's fine. It's totally fine, even so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The young man looked up at her smiling face.
For a brief second, a faint film glazed over his surprised eyes.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
…………
Sorry, C.B.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Muttering those words, the young man bowed
and walked away from the spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Though her footsteps were still unsteady, her gaze seemed fixed squarely ahead."
